(c) The NFA Letter is in full force and effect, has not been revoked, modified, or appealed, and the Borrower is in compliance with each of its conditions, except as disclosed in Schedule 5.9. (d) The Borrower has not received any notice that the Land Use Restriction has not been recorded, or that the Soil Management Plan is required and has not been submitted. (e) Neither the Borrower nor any Guarantor has any knowledge of any condition at the Property that would reasonably be expected to give rise to liability under CERCLA or any other Environmental Law, including any liability as a result of the presence of the former underground storage tank described in the Phase I ESA. (f) No underground storage tanks are currently located on the Property, and no asbestos-containing materials or lead-based paint remain on the Property following the abatement described in the Phase I ESA.

The Construction Contract is a GMP contract with a GMP of $34,750,000 and contains no cost-escalation, allowance, or savings-sharing provision that would permit the GMP to be exceeded without an approved Change Order, except as disclosed in Schedule 5.10. The Approved Plans and Specifications are complete and adequate for the construction of the Project, and no portion of the Work has been performed other than as disclosed in the draw schedule or as described in the Title Policy.

**Section 5.11 — Insurance.** The Borrower maintains, and will maintain, each insurance coverage required by Article VI and **Exhibit G**, and each policy is in full force and effect with premiums paid.

**Section 5.12 — Solvency; No Bankruptcy.** The Borrower and each Guarantor are solvent, are able to pay their debts as they become due, and have no intent to hinder, delay, or defraud any creditor. No Bankruptcy Event has occurred with respect to the Borrower, any Guarantor, or any member of the Borrower. The Borrower did not incur the Loan with the intent to incur debts beyond its ability to pay.

**Section 5.13 — Affiliate Transactions; Mezzanine Loan.** Except as disclosed in Schedule 5.13, the Borrower has no transactions with any Affiliate other than on arm's-length terms. Brightleaf Investors Group LLC, a 28% member of the Borrower, and Brightleaf Mezzanine Capital LLC, the Mezzanine Lender, are under the common control of Thomas R. Chen. The Borrower has disclosed to the Lender all agreements between or among the Borrower, any member, the Mezzanine Lender, and any Affiliate of any of them, and no such agreement is inconsistent with the Loan Documents or the Intercreditor Agreement. The Mezzanine Documents delivered to the Lender are true, correct, and complete, and the Mezzanine Loan is not in default.

**Section 5.14 — Single-Purpose Entity.** The Borrower is, and since its formation has been, a single-purpose entity whose sole business is the acquisition, development, construction, ownership, leasing, and operation of the Property. The Borrower has no subsidiaries, has conducted no other business, and does not hold any asset other than the Property and the assets related to the Project.

**Section 5.15 — Investment Company; ERISA; Margin Regulations.** The Borrower is not an "investment company" within the meaning of the Investment Company Act of 1940. The Borrower does not maintain, and the Loan does not constitute, an employee benefit plan subject to Title I of ERISA or Section 4975 of the Code; the prohibited transaction and plan asset provisions of ERISA and the Code are inapplicable to this transaction. The Loan is a commercial loan, and no portion of the proceeds will be used to purchase or carry margin stock within the meaning of Regulations T, U, or X of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System.

**Section 5.16 — Anti-Corruption; Sanctions.** Neither the Borrower, any Guarantor, nor any member of the Borrower is (a) a person named on the Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List maintained by the U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control or on any other similar list, or (b) organized, resident, or located in a comprehensively sanctioned jurisdiction. No portion of the Loan proceeds will be used, directly or indirectly, to fund any activity prohibited by applicable anti-money laundering, anti-corruption, or economic sanctions laws.

**Section 5.17 — No Broker.** No broker, finder, or placement agent is entitled to any commission or fee in connection with the Loan as a result of any arrangement made by the Borrower or any Guarantor.

**Section 5.18 — Accuracy of the Record.** The Borrower acknowledges that the Lender has relied on the Term Sheet dated January 10, 2025, the Credit Memorandum, the Appraisal, the Phase I ESA, the Title Commitment, and the Provided Information. The Borrower further acknowledges that (a) the Form of the Term Sheet characterizes the NFA Letter as authorizing commercial use of the Restricted Area conditioned on installation of a soil vapor mitigation system, and the Borrower has reviewed the NFA Letter and understands that the NFA Letter additionally restricts the Restricted Area to non-residential use and requires the recording of the Land Use Restriction and the preparation of a Soil Management Plan, and (b) the Project as designed includes residential units in the building above the Restricted Area, which the Lender has identified as requiring resolution under Section 6.5(d).

**Section 5.19 — Survival.** The representations and warranties in this Article V shall survive the Closing, the making of each Advance, and the repayment of the Loan.

## ARTICLE VI — AFFIRMATIVE COVENANTS

Until the Loan is paid in full and all Loan Documents are terminated, the Borrower shall, and shall cause each Guarantor (as to Sections 6.6(c), 6.11, and 6.12) to:

**Section 6.2 — Compliance with Laws.** Comply in all material respects with all applicable laws, ordinances, rules, regulations, and orders of any Governmental Authority, including building codes, the City of Durham Unified Development Ordinance, the Declaration recorded in Book 6984, Page 1155, and all Environmental Laws.

**Section 6.3 — Completion of the Work.** Complete the Work in accordance with the Approved Plans and Specifications, the Approved Budget, and the construction schedule, lien-free, on or before the Construction Maturity Date, and cause Substantial Completion to occur on or before August 31, 2027.

**Section 6.4 — Condition and Repair; Operation.** Maintain the Property in good condition and repair, operate the Property in a commercially reasonable manner consistent with Class A mixed-use properties in the Durham market, and maintain all utilities, access, and parking serving the Property.

**Section 6.5 — Environmental Compliance; NFA Letter.** (a) Comply with all Environmental Laws and with each condition of the NFA Letter throughout the term of the Loan and thereafter for so long as such conditions remain in effect. (b) Without limiting the foregoing: (i) record the Land Use Restriction in the Durham County Registry of Deeds in accordance with condition 4 of the NFA Letter, and deliver a certified copy to the Lender, together with a title endorsement confirming its recording; (ii) prepare, submit to NCDEQ, and comply with the Soil Management Plan in accordance with condition 3 of the NFA Letter, and incorporate the Soil Management Plan into the Construction Contract and all subcontracts; (iii) cause the soil vapor mitigation system required by condition 1 of the NFA Letter to be designed by a professional engineer licensed in North Carolina, installed in accordance with the Approved Plans and Specifications, and verified by a performance test, and deliver as-built drawings and the performance verification report to NCDEQ within ninety (90) days after completion of the building foundation in the Restricted Area, with a copy to the Lender; (iv) maintain the soil vapor mitigation system in good working order for so long as required by the NFA Letter and conduct the periodic monitoring recommended in the Phase I ESA or required by NCDEQ; and (v) deliver to the Lender, within thirty (30) days after the end of each calendar year, an officer's certificate confirming continued compliance with each condition of the NFA Letter. (c) Promptly deliver to the Lender copies of all notices, orders, directives, and correspondence from or to NCDEQ or any other Governmental Authority relating to the Property or the Remediation Work. (d) **Resolution of the Residential Use Conflict.** On or before the Closing Date, or, at the Lender's sole election, as a condition to any Advance for construction work within or above the Restricted Area, the Borrower shall deliver to the Lender evidence, satisfactory to the Lender, of one of the following: (i) a written modification of the NFA Letter by NCDEQ expressly permitting residential use of the Restricted Area and of the enclosed spaces above it, subject to the installation and maintenance of the soil vapor mitigation system; (ii) written confirmation from NCDEQ that residential use of the floors above the grade-level Restricted Area is permitted provided that the required engineering controls are installed and maintained; or (iii) a redesign, approved by the Lender and reflected in the Approved Plans and Specifications and the Approved Budget, that eliminates residential use within and above the Restricted Area and, if required, an updated Appraisal and updated financial projections demonstrating continued compliance with Article VIII. **Section 6.12 — Guarantor Obligations.** Cause each Guarantor to maintain its Guaranty in full force and effect, to deliver the financial statements and certifications required by Section 6.6, and to comply with the covenants applicable to such Guarantor under the Guaranties.

Until the Loan is paid in full, the Borrower shall not, without the Lender's prior written consent (which the Lender may withhold in its sole and absolute discretion unless this Agreement expressly provides otherwise):

**Section 7.1 — Indebtedness.** Incur, assume, or permit to exist any Indebtedness other than (a) the Loan, (b) the Mezzanine Loan, and (c) trade payables incurred in the ordinary course of business and not more than ninety (90) days past due.

Following the Construction Period, distributions may be made only if no Default or Event of Default exists or would result, the Borrower is in compliance with Article VIII on a pro forma basis, and the Loan-to-Value Ratio does not exceed sixty-five percent (65%). No distribution shall be made from Loan proceeds, from the Contingency Reserve, or as a reimbursement of any member's capital contribution.

**Section 7.7 — Change Orders; Contracts.** Amend, modify, or terminate the Construction Contract or the architect's agreement in any material respect, or approve any Change Order, except in accordance with Section 4.11.

**Section 7.8 — Change in Use; Zoning.** Change the use of the Property, seek any rezoning, variance, or special use permit, or permit any use that is inconsistent with the MU-D zoning classification or the Declaration.

**Section 7.9 — Change in Business; Structure.** Engage in any business other than the ownership, development, construction, leasing, management, and operation of the Project; merge or consolidate with any Person; or dissolve, liquidate, or wind up.

**Section 7.10 — Environmental Actions.** Conduct any excavation, grading, or soil disturbance within the Restricted Area other than in compliance with the Soil Management Plan; remove, disable, or modify the soil vapor mitigation system; record any instrument that would modify or release the Land Use Restriction; or take any action that would cause the NFA Letter to be modified, revoked, or reopened.

**Section 7.11 — Mezzanine Amendments.** Amend, modify, supplement, or waive any term of the Mezzanine Documents (including maturity, interest rate, amortization, payment-in-kind provisions, collateral, or guarantees) without the Lender's prior written consent, or permit any additional advance under the Mezzanine Loan.

**Section 7.12 — Fiscal Year.** Change its Fiscal Year.

**Section 7.13 — Fraudulent Transfer.** Take any action that would render the Borrower insolvent or unable to pay its debts as they become due.

## ARTICLE VIII — FINANCIAL COVENANTS

**Section 8.1 — Loan-to-Cost Ratio.** The Loan-to-Cost Ratio shall not exceed eighty percent (80.0%) at any time during the term of the Loan, including on the Closing Date. As of the Closing Date, the Loan-to-Cost Ratio computed on the Commitment and on Total Project Costs of $56,700,000 is 83.77%. Compliance shall be achieved on or before the Closing Date solely by the means described in Section 3.9, and **Exhibit C** and **Exhibit D** shall be conformed accordingly. If the Commitment is reduced to the Reduced Commitment, the Loan-to-Cost Ratio shall be 80.00% ($45,360,000 ÷ $56,700,000) and no increase in Total Project Costs shall be required; if Total Project Costs are increased instead, the Lender shall have approved the increased costs in writing and the Borrower shall have demonstrated that the increased costs are funded from sources other than the Loan and the Mezzanine Loan to the extent necessary to maintain compliance. If at any time the Loan-to-Cost Ratio exceeds 80.0%, the Borrower shall, at the Lender's election, either (a) prepay the Loan in the amount necessary to restore compliance, without prepayment premium, or (b) deposit cash collateral in an amount sufficient to restore compliance on a net-funded basis, in each case within ten (10) Business Days after written notice.

**Section 8.2 — Loan-to-Value Ratios.** (a) The Loan-to-Value Ratio on an as-completed basis shall not exceed sixty-five percent (65.0%). (b) The Loan-to-Value Ratio on an as-stabilized basis shall not exceed sixty-five percent (65.0%). (c) The Loan-to-Value Ratios shall be measured on the Closing Date using the Appraisal and thereafter at the Lender's discretion upon any reappraisal, appraisal update, or the annual appraisal required by applicable regulatory requirements, in each case at the Borrower's expense. The Borrower acknowledges that the as-completed Loan-to-Value Ratio computed on the Commitment and the Appraisal is 65.25%, which exceeds the sixty-five percent (65.0%) limitation in this Section 8.2 and in Sections 4 and 6.2 of the Term Sheet, and that the Lender's internal credit policy applies a seventy percent (70.0%) maximum. The Lender shall, on or before the Closing Date, determine whether this covenant is to be restated at seventy percent (70.0%) or whether the Commitment is to be reduced; no Advance shall be made while the covenant as stated in this Section 8.2 is breached. *See Cover Memorandum Item M-9.*

**Section 8.3 — Debt Service Coverage Ratio.** (a) The DSCR shall not be less than 1.25x. (b) The DSCR shall be tested (i) on the Closing Date on a projected basis using the Appraisal's stabilized NOI, (ii) at the commencement of the Mini-Perm Period on a projected basis (because no trailing twelve (12)-month operating history will exist at that date), and (iii) quarterly thereafter commencing with the first full fiscal quarter following achievement of Stabilized Occupancy (defined as ninety-five percent (95%) occupancy of the residential units for two consecutive months) on a trailing twelve (12)-month basis. (c) If the DSCR is less than 1.25x at any testing date, the Borrower shall, at the Lender's election, either (i) make a principal curtailment sufficient to restore the DSCR to 1.25x, or (ii) fund a debt service reserve in an amount determined by the Lender sufficient to restore the DSCR to 1.25x (a "Debt Service Reserve"), which reserve shall be maintained for so long as the DSCR remains below 1.25x.

**Section 8.4 — Borrower Net Worth.** The Borrower shall maintain a minimum net worth of not less than Twelve Million Dollars ($12,000,000), tested annually within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of each Fiscal Year and upon the Lender's request. Net worth shall be determined in accordance with Section 1.3. If the Borrower's net worth falls below $12,000,000 solely as a result of the payment of Project costs contemplated by the Approved Budget, the Borrower shall have thirty (30) days after written notice to restore compliance, which may be satisfied by an equity contribution from the members. *See Cover Memorandum Item M-17 regarding the interaction between this covenant and the payment of soft costs and the developer fee.*

**Section 8.5 — Guarantor Liquidity.** The Guarantors shall maintain combined liquidity of not less than Five Million Dollars ($5,000,000), tested quarterly, of which not less than One Million Five Hundred Thousand Dollars ($1,500,000) shall be attributable to each Guarantor individually. "Liquidity" means cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities readily convertible to cash within thirty (30) days, determined on a basis consistent with the personal financial statements delivered to the Lender. If combined liquidity falls below $5,000,000, the Guarantors shall restore compliance within thirty (30) days after written notice.

**Section 8.6 — Compliance Certificates; Testing Mechanics.** The Borrower shall deliver a Compliance Certificate with each set of financial statements required by Section 6.6 and at each other time the Lender may reasonably request, setting forth in reasonable detail the computations necessary to demonstrate compliance with this Article VIII. The Lender's determination of compliance shall control absent manifest error. Any failure to deliver a Compliance Certificate when due shall constitute an Event of Default under Section 11.3, subject to the cure period provided in that Section.

**Section 8.7 — No Waiver by Advance.** The making of any Advance shall not constitute a waiver of any breach of this Article VIII, and the Lender may condition any Advance on the Borrower's prior compliance with this Article VIII on a pro forma basis.

## ARTICLE IX — COLLATERAL, SECURITY AND PLEDGES

**Section 9.1 — Collateral.** The Loan shall be secured by (collectively, the "Collateral"): (a) a first-priority deed of trust on the Property; (b) a first-priority assignment of rents and leases covering all present and future rents, revenues, and income from the Property; (c) a first-priority security interest in all personal property, fixtures, equipment, furniture, permits, plans, specifications, contracts, licenses, approvals, accounts, deposit accounts, and general intangibles related to the Project, perfected by UCC-1 financing statements; (d) the Collateral Assignments described in Section 9.4; and (e) the Pledge Agreements described in Section 9.5.

**Section 9.2 — Deed of Trust; Trustee.** The Deed of Trust shall be recorded in the Durham County Registry of Deeds and shall contain a power of sale exercisable in accordance with Part 6 of Article 2A of Chapter 45 of the North Carolina General Statutes. The Borrower irrevocably appoints the Trustee named in the Deed of Trust and authorizes the Lender to appoint one or more substitute trustees in accordance with N.C.G.S. § 45-10.

**Section 9.3 — Assignment of Rents and Cash Management.** The Borrower collaterally assigns to the Lender all Leases and all rents, issues, and profits of the Property. The Borrower acknowledges that the assignment is absolute and, upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, the Lender may enforce the assignment directly, including by notifying tenants to pay rents directly to the Lender, without regard to the adequacy of the Collateral, and without the appointment of a receiver.

## ARTICLE XI — EVENTS OF DEFAULT

Each of the following shall constitute an Event of Default:

**Section 11.1 — Payment.** The Borrower fails to pay any principal, interest, fee, or other amount due under any Loan Document on the due date, and such failure continues for five (5) days; provided that no grace period shall apply to any payment due at the Maturity Date or after acceleration. Failure to fund a deposit required by Section 4.8 within the period specified shall be a payment default under this Section 11.1.

**Section 11.2 — Representations.** Any representation or warranty made by the Borrower, any Guarantor, or any member in any Loan Document or in any certificate, financial statement, or other document delivered under any Loan Document proves to have been untrue or misleading in any material respect when made, or any such Person omits to state a material fact necessary to make the statements made not misleading.

**Section 11.3 — Covenants.** The Borrower or any Guarantor fails to observe or perform any non-monetary covenant or obligation under the Loan Documents (other than an obligation described in Sections 11.1, 11.5, 11.7, 11.8, 11.9, 11.10, 11.11, or 11.12), and such failure continues for thirty (30) days after the earlier of (a) written notice from the Lender and (b) the date on which the Borrower obtains knowledge of such failure; provided that if the cure cannot reasonably be completed within thirty (30) days and the Borrower is diligently pursuing cure, the cure period shall be extended by an additional thirty (30) days, but in no event beyond the Construction Maturity Date for any failure relating to completion of the Work.

**Section 11.4 — Cross-Default.** (a) The Borrower or any Guarantor defaults under any other Indebtedness in an aggregate principal amount exceeding $500,000, and such default continues beyond any applicable cure period; (b) an event of default occurs under the Mezzanine Documents or the Intercreditor Agreement; or (c) an event of default occurs under any other material agreement to which the Borrower is a party, including the Construction Contract, and such default continues beyond any applicable cure period.

**Section 11.5 — Bankruptcy; Insolvency.** A Bankruptcy Event occurs with respect to the Borrower, any Guarantor, or any member of the Borrower, whether voluntary or involuntary.

**Section 11.6 — Material Adverse Change.** A material adverse change occurs in the financial condition of the Borrower or any Guarantor, or in the value, condition, or marketability of the Property or the Project, as determined by the Lender in its reasonable discretion.

**Section 11.7 — Construction Delay.** The Work is more than ninety (90) days behind the approved construction schedule at any time during the Construction Period, or Substantial Completion has not occurred on or before the Construction Maturity Date. A construction delay default under this Section 11.7 is not subject to any notice or cure period.

**Section 11.8 — Abandonment; Suspension.** The Borrower or the General Contractor abandons the Project, or the Work is suspended for a period of thirty (30) consecutive days for any reason other than a Lender-caused delay or a force majeure event approved in writing by the Lender.

**Section 11.9 — Insurance.** The Borrower fails to maintain any insurance required by Article VI, and such failure continues for ten (10) days after written notice.

**Section 11.10 — Single-Purpose Entity.** The Borrower breaches any covenant in Article XIV, or the Borrower's organizational documents are amended in a manner inconsistent with Article XIV.

**Section 11.11 — Environmental.** (a) Any material violation of any Environmental Law occurs at or affecting the Property; (b) any environmental order, directive, notice of violation, or lien is issued or recorded against the Property; (c) the NFA Letter is revoked, modified, or reopened in a manner adverse to the Lender, or the Borrower fails to comply with any condition of the NFA Letter, including the recording of the Land Use Restriction, the preparation and implementation of the Soil Management Plan, the installation, verification, or maintenance of the soil vapor mitigation system, or the non-residential use restriction; or (d) residential occupancy of any space within or above the Restricted Area occurs without the Lender's prior written consent and satisfaction of Section 6.5(d).

**Section 11.12 — Judgments.** One or more judgments, orders, or decrees for the payment of money in an aggregate amount exceeding $500,000 are entered against the Borrower or any Guarantor and remain unsatisfied, unbonded, or unstayed for a period of thirty (30) days, or any judgment results in the creation of a lien on the Property.

**Section 11.13 — Guarantor Events.** (a) Any Guarantor's net worth falls below the threshold set forth in Section 11.13(c); (b) any Guarantor revokes, terminates, disaffirms, or attempts to limit its obligations under any Guaranty; (c) any Guarantor's net worth, determined in accordance with Section 1.3, falls below Fifteen Million Dollars ($15,000,000); or (d) any Guarantor dies or becomes incapacitated. *See Cover Memorandum Item M-14 concerning the defective cross-reference in Section 15 of the Term Sheet, which refers to the Borrower's net worth covenant in Section 6.4 for a Guarantor threshold that does not exist.*

## ARTICLE XIII — INDEMNIFICATION AND EXPENSES

**Section 13.1 — General Indemnity.** The Borrower and each Guarantor shall, jointly and severally, indemnify, defend (with counsel reasonably acceptable to the Lender), and hold harmless the Lender, its officers, directors, employees, agents, and counsel from and against any and all losses, claims, damages, liabilities, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees and costs of investigation and defense) arising out of or relating to (a) the Loan Documents or the transactions contemplated thereby, (b) the Property or the Project, including any claim arising from the Work, any mechanic's or materialmen's lien, any design or construction defect, or any claim by any contractor, subcontractor, tenant, or member, (c) any Environmental Claim (as to which the Environmental Indemnity shall additionally apply), or (d) any act or omission of the Borrower, any Guarantor, any member, the General Contractor, or any of their respective agents.

The Borrower's obligations to indemnify under Section 13.1 are not released, limited, or impaired by any of the circumstances described in this Section 13.2 except as expressly stated.

**Section 14.2 — Independent Manager.** The Operating Agreement shall at all times require the Borrower to have at least one Independent Manager who (a) is not, and has not been within five (5) years prior to appointment, an officer, employee, director, manager, member, shareholder, creditor, or Affiliate of the Borrower, of any member of the Borrower, of the Mezzanine Lender, or of Thomas R. Chen; (b) is not a relative of any of the foregoing; and (c) is an individual with at least three (3) years of experience in commercial real estate or corporate governance. The affirmative vote of the Independent Manager shall be required for the Borrower to (i) file a voluntary petition under any Debtor Relief Law, (ii) consent to the appointment of a receiver, or (iii) make an assignment for the benefit of creditors. The Operating Agreement shall further provide that the Independent Manager's vote is not subject to member direction or removal except for cause, and that the 75% member approval requirement in Section 3.2 of the Operating Agreement shall not apply to actions taken under the Loan Documents, including the granting of security, the exercise of the Lender's remedies, any extension under Section 2.12, and any refinancing of the Loan. *See Cover Memorandum Item M-2.*

**Section 15.1 — Notices.** All notices, requests, demands, and other communications shall be in writing and shall be deemed given (a) when delivered personally, (b) one (1) Business Day after deposit with a nationally recognized overnight courier, (c) three (3) Business Days after deposit in the United States mail, certified and return receipt requested, postage prepaid, or (d) when sent by electronic mail, provided that the sender receives no automated rejection, in each case addressed as follows (or to such other address as a party may designate by notice):

L. 107-56), the Lender is required to obtain, verify, and record information that identifies the Borrower and each Guarantor, and the Borrower and each Guarantor shall provide such information upon request. Each of the Borrower and the Guarantors represents and covenants that neither it nor any of its beneficial owners is a sanctioned person or is engaged in any activity prohibited by applicable economic sanctions laws.

**Section 15.13 — Usury.** The provisions of Section 2.8(b) are incorporated by reference and shall control over any conflicting provision of any Loan Document.

**Section 15.14 — Joint and Several Liability.** The obligations of the Borrower and the Guarantors under the Loan Documents are joint and several, and the Lender may proceed against any one or more of them in any order.

**Section 15.15 — Waiver of Marshalling; No Notice of Disbursement.** The Borrower waives any right to require the Lender to marshal assets or to proceed against any particular portion of the Collateral in any order, and waives notice of the making of any Advance.

**Section 15.16 — Survival.** All representations, warranties, covenants, indemnities, and obligations that by their nature are intended to survive, including those in Articles V, X, XIII, and XIV and Sections 2.8, 10.4, and 15.11, shall survive the Closing, the repayment of the Loan, the release of the Collateral, and the termination of the other Loan Documents.

**Section 15.17 — Third-Party Beneficiaries.** Except for the Lender's officers, directors, employees, agents, and counsel (as to Article XIII), no Person that is not a party to this Agreement shall have any rights as a third-party beneficiary.

**Section 15.18 — Attorneys' Fees.** In any action or proceeding to enforce or interpret any Loan Document, the prevailing party shall be entitled to recover its reasonable attorneys' fees and costs in addition to any other relief awarded.

**Section 15.19 — Further Assurances.** The Borrower and each Guarantor shall execute and deliver such further documents and take such further actions as the Lender may reasonably request to carry out the purposes of the Loan Documents.

**Section 15.20 — Declarations of Intent.** The Borrower acknowledges that (a) the Interest Reserve is not a debt service reserve and does not limit the Borrower's obligation to pay interest; (b) the Lender has made no commitment to provide permanent financing beyond the Facility Maturity Date; (c) the Lender has not made any representation as to the tax consequences of the Loan or the Project; and (d) the Borrower has not relied on any statement, projection, or analysis of the Lender in entering into the Loan Documents other than the express terms hereof.

**Section 15.22 — Anti-Terrorism and Anti-Money Laundering Compliance.** The Borrower shall comply with all applicable anti-money laundering and economic sanctions laws and shall promptly notify the Lender of any change in its beneficial ownership.

**Section 15.23 — Relationship to Credit Memorandum.** The Borrower acknowledges that the Credit Memorandum is an internal document of the Lender, has not been delivered to the Borrower, and does not create any rights in favor of the Borrower. **Section 13.4 — Contest Rights.** The Borrower may contest any tax, lien, or claim in good faith by appropriate proceedings, provided that (a) such contest does not subject the Lender to any risk of criminal liability or to any risk of forfeiture or loss of the Property or any material portion thereof, (b) the Borrower provides such reserves or bonds as the Lender may reasonably require, and (c) if the contest relates to a lien on the Property, the Borrower obtains and maintains a title endorsement or bond reasonably acceptable to the Lender.

**Section 13.5 — Survival.** The obligations of the Borrower and the Guarantors under this Article XIII shall survive repayment of the Loan, the release of the Collateral, and the termination of the other Loan Documents.

## ARTICLE XIV — SINGLE-PURPOSE ENTITY COVENANTS

**Section 14.1 — Separateness Covenants.** The Borrower shall at all times: (a) hold no assets other than the Property and the assets related to the Project; (b) incur no liabilities other than the Loan, the Mezzanine Loan, and trade payables incurred in the ordinary course; (c) conduct no business other than the ownership, development, construction, leasing, management, and operation of the Project; (d) maintain its own books, records, financial statements, and bank accounts separate from those of any member, Affiliate, or other Person; (e) not commingle its funds or other assets with those of any member, Affiliate, or other Person; (f) hold itself out as, and conduct its affairs in, its own name as a separate and distinct entity; (g) observe all organizational formalities, including holding meetings, maintaining records, and making required filings with the North Carolina Secretary of State; (h) pay its own liabilities and expenses from its own funds; (i) maintain an arm's-length relationship with its members and Affiliates and not guarantee or become obligated for the debts of any member or Affiliate; (j) not acquire obligations or securities of any member or Affiliate; (k) allocate fairly and reasonably any shared expenses, if any, with any Affiliate; (l) use separate stationery, invoices, and checks; and (m) correct any known misunderstanding regarding its separate identity.

**Section 14.2 — Independent Manager.** The Operating Agreement shall at all times require the Borrower to have at least one Independent Manager who (a) is not, and has not been within five (5) years prior to appointment, an officer, employee, director, manager, member, shareholder, creditor, or Affiliate of the Borrower, of any member of the Borrower, of the Mezzanine Lender, or of Thomas R. Chen; (b) is not a relative of any of the foregoing; and (c) is an individual with at least three (3) years of experience in commercial real estate or corporate governance. The affirmative vote of the Independent Manager shall be required for the Borrower to (i) file a voluntary petition under any Debtor Relief Law, (ii) consent to the appointment of a receiver, or (iii) make an assignment for the benefit of creditors. The Operating Agreement shall further provide that the Independent Manager's vote is not subject to member direction or removal except for cause, and that the 75% member approval requirement in Section 3.2 of the Operating Agreement shall not apply to actions taken under the Loan Documents, including the granting of security, the exercise of the Lender's remedies, any extension under Section 2.12, and any refinancing of the Loan. *See Cover Memorandum Item M-2.*

**Section 14.3 — Non-Consolidation Opinion.** The Borrower shall deliver the Non-Consolidation Opinion at Closing and shall deliver an updated or bring-down opinion at any time the Lender reasonably requests, including as a condition to any extension or any assignment of the Loan to an Eligible Assignee.

**Section 14.4 — Limitations on Permitted Activities.** The Borrower shall not (a) form or acquire any subsidiary, (b) own any asset other than as permitted by Section 14.1(a), or (c) engage any employee, other than as necessary for the operation of the Property following Substantial Completion.

## ARTICLE XV — MISCELLANEOUS

**Section 15.1 — Notices.** All notices, requests, demands, and other communications shall be in writing and shall be deemed given (a) when delivered personally, (b) one (1) Business Day after deposit with a nationally recognized overnight courier, (c) three (3) Business Days after deposit in the United States mail, certified and return receipt requested, postage prepaid, or (d) when sent by electronic mail, provided that the sender receives no automated rejection, in each case addressed as follows (or to such other address as a party may designate by notice):

**Section 15.3 — Venue; Consent to Jurisdiction; Waiver of Jury Trial.** The exclusive venue for any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to the Loan or any Loan Document shall be the General Court of Justice of North Carolina, Durham County, or the United States District Court for the Middle District of North Carolina, and each party irrevocably consents to the jurisdiction of such courts and waives any objection based on venue or forum non conveniens. **EACH PARTY KNOWINGLY, VOLUNTARILY, AND IRREVOCABLY WAIVES ANY RIGHT TO A TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION OR PROCEEDING ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THE LOAN OR ANY LOAN DOCUMENT.**

**Section 15.4 — Assignment; Participation.** The Lender may assign, transfer, or sell participations in its interest in the Loan, in whole or in part, without the consent of the Borrower, to any Eligible Assignee, and may disclose all information relating to the Borrower, the Guarantors, and the Property to any actual or prospective assignee or participant that agrees to maintain confidentiality. The Borrower may not assign or delegate its obligations under the Loan Documents, in whole or in part, without the Lender's prior written consent, which may be withheld in the Lender's sole discretion; any purported assignment without consent shall be void.

**Section 15.5 — Amendments; No Oral Modification.** No amendment, modification, waiver, or supplement of any Loan Document shall be effective unless in writing and signed by the Lender and the party against whom enforcement is sought. No course of dealing, usage of trade, or failure to insist upon strict performance shall constitute a waiver or amendment.

**Section 15.6 — Severability.** If any provision of any Loan Document is held invalid, illegal, or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect, and the invalid provision shall be reformed to the minimum extent necessary to make it enforceable.

**Section 15.7 — Counterparts; Electronic Signatures.** This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be an original and all of which together shall constitute one instrument. Signatures delivered by electronic means (including PDF and DocuSign) shall be deemed original signatures for all purposes.

**Section 15.8 — Entire Agreement.** This Agreement, together with the other Loan Documents, constitutes the entire agreement among the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior negotiations, term sheets, commitments, and understandings, including the Term Sheet dated January 10, 2025, **except that Sections 22 and 23 of the Term Sheet (Confidentiality, Exclusivity, Expense Deposit, and Acceptance) shall survive to the extent not inconsistent with this Agreement.**

**Section 15.9 — Time of the Essence.** Time is of the essence with respect to each obligation of the Borrower and each Guarantor under the Loan Documents.

**Section 15.10 — No Partnership or Agency.** Nothing in the Loan Documents creates a partnership, joint venture, or agency relationship between the Lender and the Borrower, and the Lender is not a partner, joint venturer, or agent of the Borrower.

**Section 15.11 — Confidentiality.** The Lender shall maintain the confidentiality of the Borrower's non-public financial information in accordance with its customary practices and applicable law, except that the Lender may disclose such information (a) to its Affiliates, officers, employees, agents, counsel, auditors, and regulators, (b) to any actual or prospective assignee or participant, (c) as required by law, regulation, subpoena, or court order, and (d) in connection with the enforcement of the Loan Documents.

**Section 15.12 — USA PATRIOT Act; OFAC.** The Lender hereby notifies the Borrower that, pursuant to the requirements of the USA PATRIOT Act (Title III of Pub. L. 107-56), the Lender is required to obtain, verify, and record information that identifies the Borrower and each Guarantor, and the Borrower and each Guarantor shall provide such information upon request. Each of the Borrower and the Guarantors represents and covenants that neither it nor any of its beneficial owners is a sanctioned person or is engaged in any activity prohibited by applicable economic sanctions laws.

**Section 15.13 — Usury.** The provisions of Section 2.8(b) are incorporated by reference and shall control over any conflicting provision of any Loan Document.

**Section 15.14 — Joint and Several Liability.** The obligations of the Borrower and the Guarantors under the Loan Documents are joint and several, and the Lender may proceed against any one or more of them in any order.

**Section 15.15 — Waiver of Marshalling; No Notice of Disbursement.** The Borrower waives any right to require the Lender to marshal assets or to proceed against any particular portion of the Collateral in any order, and waives notice of the making of any Advance.

**Section 15.16 — Survival.** All representations, warranties, covenants, indemnities, and obligations that by their nature are intended to survive, including those in Articles V, X, XIII, and XIV and Sections 2.8, 10.4, and 15.11, shall survive the Closing, the repayment of the Loan, the release of the Collateral, and the termination of the other Loan Documents.

**Section 15.17 — Third-Party Beneficiaries.** Except for the Lender's officers, directors, employees, agents, and counsel (as to Article XIII), no Person that is not a party to this Agreement shall have any rights as a third-party beneficiary.

**Section 15.18 — Attorneys' Fees.** In any action or proceeding to enforce or interpret any Loan Document, the prevailing party shall be entitled to recover its reasonable attorneys' fees and costs in addition to any other relief awarded.

**Section 15.19 — Further Assurances.** The Borrower and each Guarantor shall execute and deliver such further documents and take such further actions as the Lender may reasonably request to carry out the purposes of the Loan Documents.

**Section 15.20 — Declarations of Intent.** The Borrower acknowledges that (a) the Interest Reserve is not a debt service reserve and does not limit the Borrower's obligation to pay interest; (b) the Lender has made no commitment to provide permanent financing beyond the Facility Maturity Date; (c) the Lender has not made any representation as to the tax consequences of the Loan or the Project; and (d) the Borrower has not relied on any statement, projection, or analysis of the Lender in entering into the Loan Documents other than the express terms hereof.

{"command": "cd $WORKSPACE_DIR && cat > build/style2.py <<'PY'
import sys, json, copy
import docx
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_BREAK
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
from docx.text.paragraph import Paragraph

FONT = "Times New Roman"

def set_run_font(run, size=None, bold=None, italic=None, color=None, caps=None):
    run.font.name = FONT
    rpr = run._element.get_or_add_rPr()
    rf = rpr.find(qn('w:rFonts'))
    if rf is None:
        rf = OxmlElement('w:rFonts'); rpr.append(rf)
    for a in ('w:ascii','w:hAnsi','w:cs','w:eastAsia'):
        rf.set(qn(a), FONT)
    if size is not None: run.font.size = Pt(size)
    if bold is not None: run.font.bold = bold
    if italic is not None: run.font.italic = italic
    if caps: run.font.all_caps = True
    if color is not None: run.font.color.rgb = color

def field(paragraph, code):
    run = paragraph.add_run()
    f1 = OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); f1.set(qn('w:fldCharType'), 'begin')
    it = OxmlElement('w:instrText'); it.set(qn('xml:space'), 'preserve'); it.text = code
    f2 = OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); f2.set(qn('w:fldCharType'), 'end')
    run._r.append(f1); run._r.append(it); run._r.append(f2)
    return run

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    sh = OxmlElement('w:shd'); sh.set(qn('w:val'),'clear'); sh.set(qn('w:color'),'auto'); sh.set(qn('w:fill'),hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(sh)

def repeat_header(row):
    trPr = row._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    el = OxmlElement('w:tblHeader'); el.set(qn('w:val'), 'true'); trPr.append(el)

def set_borders(table):
    tblPr = table._tbl.tblPr
    borders = OxmlElement('w:tblBorders')
    for edge in ('top','left','bottom','right','insideH','insideV'):
        e = OxmlElement('w:'+edge)
        e.set(qn('w:val'),'single'); e.set(qn('w:sz'),'4'); e.set(qn('w:space'),'0'); e.set(qn('w:color'),'999999')
        borders.append(e)
    tblPr.append(borders)

def set_table_width(table, total_in):
    tblPr = table._tbl.tblPr
    for el in tblPr.findall(qn('w:tblW')):
        tblPr.remove(el)
    w = OxmlElement('w:tblW'); w.set(qn('w:type'),'dxa'); w.set(qn('w:w'), str(int(total_in*1440)))
    tblPr.append(w)
    lay = OxmlElement('w:tblLayout'); lay.set(qn('w:type'),'fixed'); tblPr.append(lay)
    ncols = len(table.columns)
    widths = [total_in/ncols]*ncols
    # widen first column for label/description tables
    if ncols in (2,3):
        widths[0] = total_in*0.32; widths[-1] = total_in - widths[0] - (total_in*0.34 if ncols==3 else 0)
    if ncols >= 9:
        widths = [total_in*0.055, total_in*0.20] + [ (total_in*0.745)/(ncols-2) ]*(ncols-2)
    for i, col in enumerate(table.columns):
        col.width = Inches(round(widths[i],3))
    for row in table.rows:
        for i, cell in enumerate(row.cells):
            if i < len(widths):
                cell.width = Inches(round(widths[i],3))

def insert_break_para_before(par):
    newp = OxmlElement('w:p')
    par._p.addprevious(newp)
    p = Paragraph(newp, par._parent)
    p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
    return p

def add_sectpr_to_para(p, sectPr_template, landscape=False):
    pPr = p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    sp = copy.deepcopy(sectPr_template)
    if landscape:
        pgSz = sp.find(qn('w:pgSz'))
        pgSz.set(qn('w:w'), '15840'); pgSz.set(qn('w:h'), '12240')
        pgSz.set(qn('w:orient'), 'landscape')
        mar = sp.find(qn('w:pgMar'))
        mar.set(qn('w:top'),'864'); mar.set(qn('w:bottom'),'864')
        mar.set(qn('w:left'),'1080'); mar.set(qn('w:right'),'1080')
        mar.set(qn('w:header'),'432'); mar.set(qn('w:footer'),'432')
    pPr.append(sp)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
    for r in p.runs: r.font.size = Pt(1)

def main(cfg):
    path = cfg['path']
    doc = docx.Document(path)
    for s in doc.sections:
        s.page_width = Inches(8.5); s.page_height = Inches(11)
        s.left_margin = Inches(1.0); s.right_margin = Inches(1.0)
        s.top_margin = Inches(1.0); s.bottom_margin = Inches(1.0)

    normal = doc.styles['Normal']
    normal.font.name = FONT; normal.font.size = Pt(11)
    rpr = normal.element.get_or_add_rPr()
    rf = rpr.find(qn('w:rFonts'))
    if rf is None:
        rf = OxmlElement('w:rFonts'); rpr.append(rf)
    for a in ('w:ascii','w:hAnsi','w:cs','w:eastAsia'):
        rf.set(qn(a), FONT)
    pf = normal.paragraph_format
    pf.space_before = Pt(0); pf.space_after = Pt(6); pf.line_spacing = 1.12
    pf.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY

    for name, size, align, before, after in (('Heading 1', 13, WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER, 12, 6),
                                             ('Heading 2', 11.5, WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER, 14, 6),
                                             ('Heading 3', 11, WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT, 10, 4)):
        try: st = doc.styles[name]
        except KeyError: continue
        st.font.name = FONT; st.font.size = Pt(size); st.font.bold = True
        st.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0,0,0); st.font.italic = False
        st.paragraph_format.alignment = align
        st.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(before); st.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(after)
        st.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True; st.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.0

    # ---------- COVER ----------
    toc_marker = cfg.get('toc_marker', 'TABLE OF CONTENTS')
    paras = doc.paragraphs
    toc_idx = next((i for i,p in enumerate(paras) if p.text.strip().upper().startswith(toc_marker)), None)
    if toc_idx:
        cover = paras[:toc_idx]
        for i,p in enumerate(cover):
            t = p.text.strip()
            if not t: continue
            p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
            p.paragraph_format.first_line_indent = Inches(0)
            p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)
            if i == 0:
                for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=19, bold=True)
                p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(70); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(8)
            elif t.startswith('('):
                for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=11.5, italic=True)
            elif t == 'THE PIEDMONT AT BRIGHTLEAF':
                for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=15, bold=True)
                p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(24)
            elif t in ('BETWEEN','AND'):
                for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=10.5, bold=True)
                p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(18)
            elif t.startswith('DRAFT'):
                for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=11, bold=True)
                p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(30)
            elif t.startswith('Prepared by') or t.startswith('This draft'):
                for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=8.5, italic=True)
                p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(0.55); p.paragraph_format.right_indent = Inches(0.55)
                p.paragraph_format.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
            else:
                for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=11)
        cover[-1].add_run().add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

    for p in doc.paragraphs:
        if p.text.strip().upper().startswith(toc_marker):
            p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
            p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(10)
            for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=12, bold=True)
            break

    # ---------- LANDSCAPE RANGES ----------
    lr = cfg.get('landscape', [])
    body_sectPr = doc.element.body.find(qn('w:sectPr'))
    for r in lr:
        start = next((p for p in doc.paragraphs if p.text.strip().upper().startswith(r['start'].upper())), None)
        end = next((p for p in doc.paragraphs if p.text.strip().upper().startswith(r['end'].upper())), None)
        if not start or not end:
            print("landscape markers not found", r); continue
        pre = insert_break_para_before(start)
        add_sectpr_to_para(pre, body_sectPr, landscape=False)
        post = insert_break_para_before(end)
        add_sectpr_to_para(post, body_sectPr, landscape=True)

    # ---------- BODY ----------
    for p in doc.paragraphs:
        if p.style.name.startswith('Heading'): continue
        if not p.text.strip(): continue
        p.paragraph_format.first_line_indent = Inches(0)
        if not p.text.strip().startswith(('By:','Name:','Title:','Date:','_____','Executed this')):
            p.paragraph_format.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
        else:
            p.paragraph_format.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT

    # ---------- TABLES ----------
    for t in doc.tables:
        ncols = len(t.columns)
        total = cfg.get('wide_total', 9.0) if ncols >= 8 else 6.5
        t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
        set_borders(t); set_table_width(t, total)
        for ri,row in enumerate(t.rows):
            if ri == 0: repeat_header(row)
            for cell in row.cells:
                if ri == 0: shade(cell, 'E6E6E6')
                for p in cell.paragraphs:
                    pfx = p.paragraph_format
                    pfx.space_before = Pt(1); pfx.space_after = Pt(1); pfx.line_spacing = 1.0
                    pfx.first_line_indent = Inches(0)
                    pfx.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT
                    for r in p.runs:
                        set_run_font(r, size=cfg.get('table_font', 8), bold=(True if ri==0 else None))

    # ---------- page breaks before exhibits ----------
    for p in doc.paragraphs:
        if p.style.name.startswith('Heading'):
            up = p.text.strip().upper()
            if up.startswith(cfg.get('exhibit_prefix','EXHIBIT')) or 'SIGNATURE PAGES' in up:
                p.paragraph_format.page_break_before = True

    # ---------- header/footer ----------
    sec = doc.sections[0]
    hp = sec.header.paragraphs[0]; hp.text=''
    hp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    set_run_font(hp.add_run(cfg['header']), size=7.5, italic=True, color=RGBColor(0x55,0x55,0x55))
    fp = sec.footer.paragraphs[0]; fp.text=''
    fp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    set_run_font(fp.add_run(cfg['footer'] + "   |   Page "), size=7.5, color=RGBColor(0x55,0x55,0x55))
    set_run_font(field(fp,' PAGE '), size=7.5, color=RGBColor(0x55,0x55,0x55))
    set_run_font(fp.add_run(" of "), size=7.5, color=RGBColor(0x55,0x55,0x55))
    set_run_font(field(fp,' NUMPAGES '), size=7.5, color=RGBColor(0x55,0x55,0x55))

    doc.save(path)
    print("ok", path)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(json.loads(sys.argv[1]))

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    sh = OxmlElement('w:shd'); sh.set(qn('w:val'),'clear'); sh.set(qn('w:color'),'auto'); sh.set(qn('w:fill'),hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(sh)

def repeat_header(row):
    trPr = row._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    el = OxmlElement('w:tblHeader'); el.set(qn('w:val'), 'true'); trPr.append(el)

def set_borders(table):
    tblPr = table._tbl.tblPr
    borders = OxmlElement('w:tblBorders')
    for edge in ('top','left','bottom','right','insideH','insideV'):
        e = OxmlElement('w:'+edge)
        e.set(qn('w:val'),'single'); e.set(qn('w:sz'),'4'); e.set(qn('w:space'),'0'); e.set(qn('w:color'),'999999')
        borders.append(e)
    tblPr.append(borders)

def set_table_width(table, total_in):
    tblPr = table._tbl.tblPr
    for el in tblPr.findall(qn('w:tblW')):
        tblPr.remove(el)
    w = OxmlElement('w:tblW'); w.set(qn('w:type'),'dxa'); w.set(qn('w:w'), str(int(total_in*1440)))
    tblPr.append(w)
    lay = OxmlElement('w:tblLayout'); lay.set(qn('w:type'),'fixed'); tblPr.append(lay)
    ncols = len(table.columns)
    widths = [total_in/ncols]*ncols
    # widen first column for label/description tables
    if ncols in (2,3):
        widths[0] = total_in*0.32; widths[-1] = total_in - widths[0] - (total_in*0.34 if ncols==3 else 0)
    if ncols >= 9:
        widths = [total_in*0.055, total_in*0.20] + [ (total_in*0.745)/(ncols-2) ]*(ncols-2)
    for i, col in enumerate(table.columns):
        col.width = Inches(round(widths[i],3))
    for row in table.rows:
        for i, cell in enumerate(row.cells):
            if i < len(widths):
                cell.width = Inches(round(widths[i],3))

def insert_break_para_before(par):
    newp = OxmlElement('w:p')
    par._p.addprevious(newp)
    p = Paragraph(newp, par._parent)
    p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
    return p

def add_sectpr_to_para(p, sectPr_template, landscape=False):
    pPr = p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    sp = copy.deepcopy(sectPr_template)
    if landscape:
        pgSz = sp.find(qn('w:pgSz'))
        pgSz.set(qn('w:w'), '15840'); pgSz.set(qn('w:h'), '12240')
        pgSz.set(qn('w:orient'), 'landscape')
        mar = sp.find(qn('w:pgMar'))
        mar.set(qn('w:top'),'864'); mar.set(qn('w:bottom'),'864')
        mar.set(qn('w:left'),'1080'); mar.set(qn('w:right'),'1080')
        mar.set(qn('w:header'),'432'); mar.set(qn('w:footer'),'432')
    pPr.append(sp)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
    for r in p.runs: r.font.size = Pt(1)

def main(cfg):
    path = cfg['path']
    doc = docx.Document(path)
    for s in doc.sections:
        s.page_width = Inches(8.5); s.page_height = Inches(11)
        s.left_margin = Inches(1.0); s.right_margin = Inches(1.0)
        s.top_margin = Inches(1.0); s.bottom_margin = Inches(1.0)

    normal = doc.styles['Normal']
    normal.font.name = FONT; normal.font.size = Pt(11)
    rpr = normal.element.get_or_add_rPr()
    rf = rpr.find(qn('w:rFonts'))
    if rf is None:
        rf = OxmlElement('w:rFonts'); rpr.append(rf)
    for a in ('w:ascii','w:hAnsi','w:cs','w:eastAsia'):
        rf.set(qn(a), FONT)
    pf = normal.paragraph_format
    pf.space_before = Pt(0); pf.space_after = Pt(6); pf.line_spacing = 1.12
    pf.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY

    for name, size, align, before, after in (('Heading 1', 13, WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER, 12, 6),
                                             ('Heading 2', 11.5, WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER, 14, 6),
                                             ('Heading 3', 11, WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT, 10, 4)):
        try: st = doc.styles[name]
        except KeyError: continue
        st.font.name = FONT; st.font.size = Pt(size); st.font.bold = True
        st.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0,0,0); st.font.italic = False
        st.paragraph_format.alignment = align
        st.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(before); st.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(after)
        st.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True; st.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.0

    # ---------- COVER ----------
    toc_marker = cfg.get('toc_marker', 'TABLE OF CONTENTS')
    paras = doc.paragraphs
    toc_idx = next((i for i,p in enumerate(paras) if p.text.strip().upper().startswith(toc_marker)), None)
    if toc_idx:
        cover = paras[:toc_idx]
        for i,p in enumerate(cover):
            t = p.text.strip()
            if not t: continue
            p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
            p.paragraph_format.first_line_indent = Inches(0)
            p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)
            if i == 0:
                for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=19, bold=True)
                p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(70); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(8)
            elif t.startswith('('):
                for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=11.5, italic=True)
            elif t == 'THE PIEDMONT AT BRIGHTLEAF':
                for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=15, bold=True)
                p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(24)
            elif t in ('BETWEEN','AND'):
                for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=10.5, bold=True)
                p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(18)
            elif t.startswith('DRAFT'):
                for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=11, bold=True)
                p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(30)
            elif t.startswith('Prepared by') or t.startswith('This draft'):
                for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=8.5, italic=True)
                p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(0.55); p.paragraph_format.right_indent = Inches(0.55)
                p.paragraph_format.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
            else:
                for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=11)
        cover[-1].add_run().add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

    for p in doc.paragraphs:
        if p.text.strip().upper().startswith(toc_marker):
            p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
            p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(10)
            for r in p.runs: set_run_font(r, size=12, bold=True)
            break

    # ---------- LANDSCAPE RANGES ----------
    lr = cfg.get('landscape', [])
    body_sectPr = doc.element.body.find(qn('w:sectPr'))
    for r in lr:
        start = next((p for p in doc.paragraphs if p.text.strip().upper().startswith(r['start'].upper())), None)
        end = next((p for p in doc.paragraphs if p.text.strip().upper().startswith(r['end'].upper())), None)
        if not start or not end:
            print("landscape markers not found", r); continue
        pre = insert_break_para_before(start)
        add_sectpr_to_para(pre, body_sectPr, landscape=False)
        post = insert_break_para_before(end)
        add_sectpr_to_para(post, body_sectPr, landscape=True)

    # ---------- BODY ----------
    for p in doc.paragraphs:
        if p.style.name.startswith('Heading'): continue
        if not p.text.strip(): continue
        p.paragraph_format.first_line_indent = Inches(0)
        if not p.text.strip().startswith(('By:','Name:','Title:','Date:','_____','Executed this')):
            p.paragraph_format.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
        else:
            p.paragraph_format.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT

    # ---------- TABLES ----------
    for t in doc.tables:
        ncols = len(t.columns)
        total = cfg.get('wide_total', 9.0) if ncols >= 8 else 6.5
        t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
        set_borders(t); set_table_width(t, total)
        for ri,row in enumerate(t.rows):
            if ri == 0: repeat_header(row)
            for cell in row.cells:
                if ri == 0: shade(cell, 'E6E6E6')
                for p in cell.paragraphs:
                    pfx = p.paragraph_format
                    pfx.space_before = Pt(1); pfx.space_after = Pt(1); pfx.line_spacing = 1.0
                    pfx.first_line_indent = Inches(0)
                    pfx.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT
                    for r in p.runs:
                        set_run_font(r, size=cfg.get('table_font', 8), bold=(True if ri==0 else None))

    # ---------- page breaks before exhibits ----------
    for p in doc.paragraphs:
        if p.style.name.startswith('Heading'):
            up = p.text.strip().upper()
            if up.startswith(cfg.get('exhibit_prefix','EXHIBIT')) or 'SIGNATURE PAGES' in up:
                p.paragraph_format.page_break_before = True

    # ---------- header/footer ----------
    sec = doc.sections[0]
    hp = sec.header.paragraphs[0]; hp.text=''
    hp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    set_run_font(hp.add_run(cfg['header']), size=7.5, italic=True, color=RGBColor(0x55,0x55,0x55))
    fp = sec.footer.paragraphs[0]; fp.text=''
    fp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    set_run_font(fp.add_run(cfg['footer'] + "   |   Page "), size=7.5, color=RGBColor(0x55,0x55,0x55))
    set_run_font(field(fp,' PAGE '), size=7.5, color=RGBColor(0x55,0x55,0x55))
    set_run_font(fp.add_run(" of "), size=7.5, color=RGBColor(0x55,0x55,0x55))
    set_run_font(field(fp,' NUMPAGES '), size=7.5, color=RGBColor(0x55,0x55,0x55))

    doc.save(path)
    print("ok", path)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(json.loads(sys.argv[1]))
